title: update CONTRIBUTING.md and add 2 PR rule
body:
Add a rule to state new contributors should open a maximum of 2 PRs to avoid overloading us maintainers. The first PRs often miss some details and then the reviewers have to tell that person to fix that on all PRs several times.

Then update the stale links to the new github org.

Lastly tweak some minor wording about who reviews and merges and remove the team pings because they do not work for external people. Only people part of the org can ping teams and just refer to our generic communication channels.
